speaker: abel_garnish
text: Stop there. The vizard is over your mouth, and you have given the Princess the line that belongs to Rosaline.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The vizard smells of glue, Abel, and it hides half the room. How art thou to have me tell which lady holds the favour?

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: By where we stand, Master Burbage. I am the shorter. Arthur is the taller, even when he tries not to be.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I do not stoop, Nick. I bend, and the cuff is still short of the wrist.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep apart when you change the favours. If you cluster, the gallery sees four Russian backs and no faces.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give me two paces when I swear to the wrong mask, or the rhyme goes into the hangings.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Two paces to your left and you are on my side, sir. There is no train today. The watchet is not on me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And it will not be, today. Fifty shillings is still the mercer's. Thou art the Princess in thy own doublet.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have stood at this post with a shield the size of a lid. When the Worthies come, how many mock Hector at once?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three, Tom, and each of them thinks himself the wit, until the country fellow shames them.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: From the King's return, then. Master Pope at the post. I have the place. I have no count of lines, and I am not starting one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let them laugh at the pedant before the messenger comes. Berowne can bear the laugh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They shall have the laugh, Dick, so long as the boys have room to send it back.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: We can send it back, sir. I have the glove in my hand. It is a glove. It is not a gown.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I have the other favour. I will not drop it unless the shield takes us both.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Mind your shins. Pompey wants dry board, and the yard is not dry.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Tomorrow we hang the plot in the yard and run it through. Today the favours change, and nobody adds a line for me to refuse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again from the Russian entry. Walking. Save the breath for when the vizards come off.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Come on, then. Let us be forsworn in order, and let the boys have the last knock.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I stand where you set me, sir.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: And I. The cuff stays where it is.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Hector will be ready when you are done being Russians. I am not starting without the book.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book is open. The column beside Costard is still empty. Begin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Begin. Dick, the rhyme goes to the yard, not to the hangings. Turn the shoulder out.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Out, then. I can see the door. I cannot see Arthur's face, and I do not need to. I need the favour.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The glove is here.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: And mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the scene can hear you. Go on. Thou, Nick, do not play her to a yard that is not here yet.
